semantic_fidelity.reason: All13 named source entities appear and paid-only software/OOB->DCGM are absent. However required single-trunk semantics, NVOS hosting, RMS SSH/SFTP and RMS/NMX gRPC ownership, explicit software residency, and two edge-label associations fail. Historical OOB->NVOS remains qualified/blocked; it is not promoted to truth.

arrow_traceability.reason: All15 drawn route instances have traceable source stems and unique target arrowheads; no actual crossing/shared corridor or OOB->DCGM connection is visible. But explicit GB300 bus exception requires ONE OOB trunk splitting ONCE; three independent source ports violate that category. The absent required RMS control paths also cannot be traced. Adjacent v1 corners are not a substitute junction.

layout_fit.reason: Physical77x47 fit at recorded default natural100% passes for all final views: complete boxes/full labels, no overlay contact; ANSI dimensions independently verified, PTY47x77 vs widget49 rows distinguished. Nonetheless this fixed category includes complete source coverage across split views, which fails for residency and required RMS/NVSwitch control. No pan/zoom rescue is credited.

conceptual_grouping_color.reason: The four-view topical separation helps, and v1 BMC/power endpoints have related pink shades. But color follows geometric depth rather than required residence groups: NVOS and its NMX software use different families; DCGM/driver/Fabric Manager use pink/green/blue, with no compute-host annotation. Repeated OOB identity changes family across views as depth changes. These are not documented source-defined residency tiers.

border_integrity.reason: Corrected selected-state coverage: all 19 displayed node occurrences have proven complete uniform unselected borders. Only four occurrences have raw evidence of their own selected state: Compute BMC in v1-a4-selected.ansi at [59,18,13,4], Compute BMC in v2-a2-selected.ansi at [19,27,13,4], NVSwitch BMC in v3-a3-selected.ansi at [36,21,14,4], and DCGM in v4-a2-selected.ansi at [26,23,6,4]. Those selected borders are complete and uniformly bold amber. The other 15 occurrences remain unselected in these frames; their own selected borders/handles are unverified. The 38 inspected rectangles are repeated frame observations, not 19 independently selected occurrences. No observed border defect is alleged. Every-node selected-state coverage is missing, so border_integrity is blocked, superseding the original pass.

findings.description: Explicit human split-once OOB bus is replaced by three independent source ports and routes. Stems are (38,17), (38,19), (38,21); corridors turn at columns 57,56,54. There is no common trunk or single split. Endpoints are readable but this violates the named-bus requirement; renderer limitations do not waive the failure. Adjacent corners at [56,19,3,1] are not a legitimate branch.

NVOS hosting NMX-C/T is not visibly expressed as hosting/residency. The actual NVOS -> NMX-C/T edge says NMX-C gRPC, promoting the management-client protocol to the host-to-component relation. The qualified requirement is NVOS hosts NMX-C/T; management gRPC belongs to the RMS control path. A generator title/prose statement cannot change the captured edge label.

Cross-view RMS NVSwitch/NMX control coverage is incomplete: v2 shows only nv-rms -> NVOS labeled NVUE REST; source-listed SSH/SFTP is absent, and there is no correctly attributed RMS -> NMX-C gRPC route. The v3 NVOS -> NMX-C/T gRPC label does not supply the missing caller relation by transitivity.

The second Redfish label at [25,26,7,1], intended by the JSON for RMS -> Compute BMC, lies below the Power shelf horizontal route and to the right of the Compute route. Blind inspection cannot assign it uniquely to Compute BMC. The correct protocol in the JSON/prose does not make its capture association reliable.

serves :9400 at [29,30,12,1], intended for DCGM -> dcgm-exporter, sits directly below the Driver+CUDA horizontal route, beyond the exporter route span (columns22-27). The capture can instead read as a second label on DCGM -> Driver+CUDA. Exporter metric-service ownership is not independently recoverable from label placement.

Required residency meaning is missing from the captured split views: nv-rms has no management-node/off-rack location label; NVOS/NMX lacks visible hosting semantics; DCGM, Driver+CUDA and Fabric Mgr have no compute-host location label. same host states only Driver+CUDA/Fabric Mgr colocation, not which host or DCGM inclusion. All13 software/device names occur, but where-the-software-runs is not complete. No literal GPU-die claim is drawn.

Color encodes graph depth rather than the source residency groups: v3 separates NVOS (light teal #93c2b7) from hosted NMX-C/T (pink #d3869b), while grouping NVOS with NVSwitch BMC (teal #7daea3). In v4 DCGM is pink, Driver+CUDA green and Fabric Mgr blue with no compute-host grouping annotation. Source-defined related software residency is not represented by a related hue family or explicit grouping. Across views OOB LAN changes teal to amber when its geometric depth changes; this is not a declared semantic legend.

The extra historical OOB LAN -> NVOS line is explicitly qualified as unconfirmed in generation.md/json, with reach hist. in the capture. It is not established by the corrected source as a required physical endpoint. Preserve the uncertainty: blocked rather than declaring the historical line true or definitely false. The abbreviation alone does not tell a capture-only reader what is uncertain.

All four final graphs physically fit the77x47 capture with complete labels and borders, but the fixed layout_fit gate also requires complete source coverage across split views. Missing RMS SSH/SFTP and correctly attributed RMS/NMX gRPC plus missing residency meaning prevent that whole category from passing. This is not a clipping finding.

Preserved final command lists include unselected TXT/ANSI reads and selected ANSI reads, but no selected-TXT read commands; selected-TXT files exist and their contents match ANSI. Exact command records for the rejected viewer attempts and their individual closure operations are also absent (only inventory, split responses and cleanup summary remain). Thus the strict exact-commands workflow gate is blocked, not a wrong-model or missing-capture failure. Cleanup is recorded done, not independently replayed.

Missing selected-state coverage, not an observed border defect. Existing selected ANSI frames prove only v1 Compute BMC [59,18,13,4], v2 Compute BMC [19,27,13,4], v3 NVSwitch BMC [36,21,14,4], and v4 DCGM [26,23,6,4] in their own selected states. Missing own-selected-state evidence: v1 nv-rms/OOB LAN/NVSwitch BMC/Power shelf; v2 nv-rms/Power shelf/NVOS; v3 OOB LAN/NVOS/NMX-C/T; v4 Kubernetes/GPU Operator/dcgm-exporter/Driver+CUDA/Fabric Mgr. These 15 occurrences remain unselected in the supplied selected-view frames. v1-a4-selected2.txt is plain text, identical to the other v1 TXT frames, and cannot establish selection identity or selected border color. All 19 unselected borders and the four actually selected borders remain proven correct. The original pass overgeneralized repeated frame observations and is superseded by blocked; workflow coverage is also blocked.

No executed shared-bus capability evidence exists. This limits repair, but F01 remains a known failure, not merely blocked. No new feature probe was run.

The physical OOB->NVOS relation remains unconfirmed under the qualified source; source-backed interface evidence is missing. Historical appearance and reach hist. do not establish it. Audit remains blocked.

Exact selected-TXT capture commands and rejected-attempt launch/closure command records are missing from preserved evidence. Final view-state files and cleanup assertions are present; this command-provenance issue is separate from the newly acknowledged per-node selected-state coverage gap and does not prove leaked panes.

Own-selected-state raw evidence is absent for 15 of 19 displayed node occurrences. Only v1 Compute BMC, v2 Compute BMC, v3 NVSwitch BMC and v4 DCGM are selected in the existing final ANSI captures. Correct unselected borders in a selected-view frame cannot establish those nodes' own selected borders/handles. Border integrity and workflow coverage are blocked; no new rendering was performed and no observed border defect is alleged.
